moves.name: Trick Room
moves.description:
Psychic (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: -7
For 5 turns, the Speed of every Pokemon is recalculated for the purposes of determining turn order. During the effect, each Pokemon's Speed is considered to be (10000 - its normal Speed), and if this value is greater than 8191, 8192 is subtracted from it. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.

moves.name: Scald
moves.description:
Water (Special)
Base Power: 80
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 30% chance to burn the target. The target thaws out if it is frozen.

moves.name: Chilly Reception
moves.description:
Ice (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
For 5 turns, the weather becomes Snow. The user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description:
Psychic (Special)
Base Power: 90
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Yawn
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
Causes the target to fall asleep at the end of the next turn. Fails when used if the target cannot fall asleep or if it already has a non-volatile status condition. At the end of the next turn, if the target is still active, does not have a non-volatile status condition, and can fall asleep, it falls asleep. If the target becomes affected, this effect cannot be prevented by Safeguard or a substitute, or by falling asleep and waking up during the effect.

moves.name: Psychic Noise
moves.description:
Psychic (Special)
Base Power: 75
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
For 2 turns, the target is prevented from restoring any HP as long as it remains active. During the effect, healing and draining moves are unusable, and Abilities and items that grant healing will not heal the user. If an affected Pokemon uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain unable to restore its HP. Pain Split and the Regenerator Ability are unaffected.

moves.name: Heal Pulse
moves.description:
Psychic (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
The target restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up. If the user has the Mega Launcher Ability, the target instead restores 3/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half down.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description:
Ice (Special)
Base Power: 110
Accuracy: 70
Priority: 0
Has a 10% chance to freeze the target. If the weather is Snow, this move does not check accuracy.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.description:
Water (Special)
Base Power: 110
Accuracy: 80
Priority: 0
No additional effect.

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: Restores 1/4 max HP when at 1/2 max HP or less. Single use.

items.name: Colbur Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Dark-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Life Orb
items.description: Holder's attacks do 1.3x damage, and it loses 1/10 its max HP after the attack.

items.name: Mental Herb
items.description: Cures holder of Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, Torment. Single use.

items.name: Shed Shell
items.description: Holder cannot be prevented from choosing to switch out by any effect.

items.name: Shell Bell
items.description: After an attack, holder gains 1/8 of the damage in HP dealt to other Pokemon.

abilities.name: Regenerator
abilities.description: This Pokemon restores 1/3 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when it switches out.

abilities.name: Oblivious
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot be infatuated or taunted. Gaining this Ability while infatuated or taunted cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

abilities.name: Own Tempo
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot be confused. Gaining this Ability while confused cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.
